notes.title: macOS Support Now Available!
notes.content:
[p]Dear Warriors, We're excited to announce that Law of the Sword is now officially available on macOS! 🗡️ 

 [b]What's New:[/b] - Full macOS compatibility - Native Apple Silicon support (M4 chips) - Optimized performance for Mac systems - Seamless cross-platform play with Windows users ⚔️  

[b]System Requirements:[/b] - macOS 15.6.1 or later - Apple Silicon M4 - 16 GB RAM minimum - 5 GB available storage space 🛡️  

[b]Getting Started:[/b] Simply download Law of the Sword from your Steam library on your Mac, and you're ready to embark on your adventure! All your progress and achievements sync across platforms.   

[b]Note for Intel Mac Users:[/b] While the game is optimized for Apple Silicon, it also runs on Intel-based Macs through Rosetta 2 compatibility. Thank you for your continued support! We're committed to bringing Law of the Sword to as many platforms as possible. See you on the battlefield!  

 [i]- The Law of the Sword[/i]

 [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45343128/4d99ee43b05aa8213632b664b54b2a7ac75f9067.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Dawn of the Law
notes.content: [p]A fresh chapter has been added - one that delves deeper into the enigmatic Law.[/p][p]Whispers of an unexpected incident ripple through the world, shifting the course of events in ways yet unseen.[/p][p]Those who understand... may find themselves one step ahead.[/p]

notes.title: Arena Mode & New Weapons Update
notes.content:
New Features:

Arena Mode: Choose your opponent and fight 1v1.

New Weapons: 3 brand new weapon types + 1 previously introduced weapon are now available in Arena.

Expanded Enemy Roster: 7 new enemies joined the battle, bringing the total number to 13.

Full Combat Freedom: Face an enemy, anytime, with any weapon in the Arena!

Sharpen your swords and step into the Arena!
